policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.107: Durable Medical Equipment and Orthotics and Prosthetics Guidelines (Rev. 08/26)
source_quote: Personal computers or mobile technology such as iPads, smart phones, iPods, personal digital assistants, etc., may be considered as medical equipment when used for the purpose of speech generating equipment when other non-medical functions are limited or disabled and that device is used as the primary source of communication for those qualifying for a speech generating device.
clinical_service_or_procedure: Speech Generating Equipment Interfaces (Tablet, Computer, Mobile Device)

criteria.description: Member qualifies for a speech generating device
Non-medical functions on personal computer or mobile device are limited or disabled
Device is used as the primary source of communication

required_documentation: Device configuration report confirming dedicated/locked communication state
review_notes: Requires dedicated software configuration restricting device solely to communication function.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.107: Durable Medical Equipment and Orthotics and Prosthetics Guidelines (Rev. 08/26)
source_quote: Medically necessary with associated physical and/or occupational therapy when both of the following are met: A. At risk of a post-burn contracture; B. The garment and physical and/or occupational therapies are being used with the intent of preventing the need for skin grafting or contractures as a result of hypertrophic scarring.

criteria.description: Member is at risk of post-burn contracture
Garment and associated PT/OT are used to prevent need for skin grafting or hypertrophic scarring contractures

required_documentation: Burn surgeon or specialist clinical assessment
Concurrent PT/OT treatment plan targeting contracture prevention
review_notes: Requires concurrent PT and/or OT therapy regimen.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.107: Durable Medical Equipment and Orthotics and Prosthetics Guidelines (Rev. 08/26)
source_quote: Not medically necessary, as it is primarily considered a safety device.
clinical_service_or_procedure: Non-wearable external defibrillator with integrated ECG analysis (HCPCS E0617)

criteria.description: Request is for non-wearable external defibrillator with integrated ECG analysis

review_notes: Deemed a safety device without medical necessity standing.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.107: Durable Medical Equipment and Orthotics and Prosthetics Guidelines (Rev. 08/26)
source_quote: Initial requests for wearable cardioverter-defibrillators (WCD) are considered medically necessary for 30 days when meeting all of the following: A. Member/enrollee is ≥ 18 years of age with increased risk of sudden cardiac death; B. One of the following: 1. Awaiting cardiac transplant; 2. Previously implanted cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) must be removed due to infection and awaiting re-implantation; 3. Newly indicated ICD delayed due to one of the following; a. Systemic infection; b. Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≤ 35% and any of the following: i. Myocardial infarction (MI) within the past 40 days;

criteria.description: Member is ≥ 18 years of age with increased risk of sudden cardiac death
Awaiting transplant, ICD explant due to infection, systemic infection delay, or LVEF ≤ 35% post-MI/CABG

required_documentation: Cardiology clinical notes documenting SCD risk
Transplant listing or ICD infection/explantation operative note
review_notes: Initial coverage is strictly limited to 30 days.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.107: Durable Medical Equipment and Orthotics and Prosthetics Guidelines (Rev. 08/26)
source_quote: Ongoing requests for WCDs are considered medically necessary and will be approved in 30-day increments (up to a total of 90 days) when meeting all of the following: A. Initial request criteria continue to be met; B. Adherence is confirmed by device reports and attestation from the ordering provider; C. Plan of care has been updated with progression towards a definitive treatment pathway.

criteria.description: Initial request criteria continue to be met
Adherence confirmed by device reports and attestation from ordering provider
Updated plan of care progressing toward definitive treatment pathway

required_documentation: Updated cardiology plan of care for permanent ICD or recovery
review_notes: Approved in 30-day increments up to a total maximum of 90 days.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.107: Durable Medical Equipment and Orthotics and Prosthetics Guidelines (Rev. 08/26)
source_quote: Not medically necessary, as there is insufficient clinical evidence to support the safety and effectiveness of non-pneumatic compression devices over the use of standard pneumatic compression devices.
clinical_service_or_procedure: Non-pneumatic compression devices (HCPCS E0678, E0679, E0680, E0681)

criteria.description: Request is for non-pneumatic compression device

review_notes: Investigational/unproven compared to standard pneumatic compression.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.107: Durable Medical Equipment and Orthotics and Prosthetics Guidelines (Rev. 08/26)
source_quote: Medically necessary for member/enrollees with diabetes who have a severe visual impairment (best corrected visual acuity of 20/200 or worse in both eyes).
clinical_service_or_procedure: Blood glucose monitor with integrated voice synthesizer (HCPCS E2100)

criteria.description: Severe visual impairment with best corrected visual acuity 20/200 or worse in both eyes

required_documentation: Ophthalmology or optometry evaluation confirming visual acuity ≤ 20/200 in both eyes
review_notes: Revision 08/26 updated language from legally blind to severe visual impairment (20/200 or worse in both eyes).

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.107: Durable Medical Equipment and Orthotics and Prosthetics Guidelines (Rev. 08/26)
source_section: Policy/Criteria - HEAT, COLD & LIGHT THERAPY EQUIPMENT
source_quote: Medically necessary when meeting both of the following: A. Refractory psoriasis; B. Documentation supports treatment at home versus alternate sites (e.g. outpatient department at hospital).
clinical_service_or_procedure: Ultraviolet panel lights (HCPCS E0691, E0692, E0693, E0694)

criteria.description: Clinical documentation supports home treatment versus outpatient facility

required_documentation: Dermatology treatment history detailing failed prior therapies
Documentation of home treatment necessity (travel/mobility constraints)
review_notes: Cabinet-style reserved for extensive BSA; panel lights for discrete body areas.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.107: Durable Medical Equipment and Orthotics and Prosthetics Guidelines (Rev. 08/26)
source_section: Policy/Criteria - HEAT, COLD & LIGHT THERAPY EQUIPMENT
source_quote: Not medically necessary for post-operative management, as research does not indicate improved outcomes in pain or edema management with the use of cold compression therapy over the use of other treatments to include conservative treatment, cold therapy alone, compression therapy alone, etc.

criteria.description: Cold pad pump requested for post-operative management
